REASONED: compared DeploymentAuthentication and operator-session module claims with the changed owners and actual callers. Exact session reads remain additive to ordinary admission; their binding device now retains alias/account policy, and automatic inventory polling does not extend idle expiry. Native-proof/relay, Project IAM, execution and other module interfaces are unchanged by this delta. No whole-system or native qualification is inferred.
